candidate_selection: First candidate passing development tests; final tests never used for repair or selection
list_index_tests: Reuse the first pilot's frozen development/final suites; these are development benchmark repetitions, not new external holdout tasks

skew_heap_tests.equivalence: Exact tree structure and values; additional multiset and heap checks, not merely set equality

performance.order: Rotate implementation order across rounds; run sequentially with no concurrent builds or API calls
performance.scope: In-process representation-inclusive calls from prebuilt arrays; Rust input cloning, baseline list construction and function work included; input parsing and printing excluded. OCaml uses array-to-list conversion and ordinary immutable value sharing. This is not an isolated kernel comparison.
performance.clocks: Rust Instant monotonic; OCaml Unix.gettimeofday wall clock
performance.candidate_policy: Measure every passing independently generated candidate; no best-of selection
performance.interpretation: Exploratory local timing, median and min/max across rounds; no universal performance claim
